nodes.label: Captio App - Case Notes Creation Form (English UI)
nodes.description: Screenshot of the Captio legal case management app showing the 'Case notes' page for case #4 - Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V. (Negocios / contrato). The UI is in English (EN language selected). The form shows a new note creation form with Title field (placeholder: 'e.g. Initial strategy, To-dos, Hearing summary...'), Parent notes section (showing 'No notes in this case yet. This will be an independent note.'), and a Note textarea ('Write here...'). A blue 'Save note' button is present. Left sidebar shows: New Client, Clients, Case notes (active), Files. Bottom-left has ES/EN language toggle with EN active and Sign out. Top-right shows user avatar 'T' for 'toledolaw'.

nodes.label: New Case Note Creation Form
nodes.description: Form for creating a new case note with Title, Parent notes selector, and Note body textarea. Supports hierarchical note organization via parent-child relationships. Save note button submits the form.
